blurb: Old-school forum, reborn — early-2000s soul, modern PHP underneath. You host it, you own it.

install.cpanel: Upload release zip to public_html, extract, point domain at public_html/retrobb/public, run web installer.
install.local: git clone https://github.com/techwiz18/retrobb.git && cd retrobb && php bin/migrate.php --seed && php -S localhost:8000 -t public/
